stories.canonical_title: Apple blocks 12 compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates
stories.known_facts: Confirmed: Apple is blocking 12 compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates that issue TLS certificates, after the private keys of eight intermediate CAs were compromised; eMudhra and Sectigo revoked the affected certificates.
